LibreChat was my favorite open source frontend/backend for interacting with LLMs. I worry this will be abandoned along the way... a database acquiring an open source AI tool?

As a LibreChat user, I'm concerned. I've seen open source projects get acquired like that, and very soon they start to have some kind of paid features, telemetry, etc. Might have to start looking for alternatives soon.
My biggest question and concern is whether or not LibreChat will end up introducing the SSO tax or other 'enterprise tier' features.

I too have LibreChat deployed for my personal use and now the only question is how long until it will inevitably be enshittified/monetized. Must feel even worse for volunteers who worked on the project.

I have been wondering why I haven't really found good self-hosted UIs that could also use plugins/functions. Just installed this (which was quite easy) and it seems to work very well! Definitely gonna replace the one I was using before.

The primary use case here seems to be that it might be possible to use this tool to spend <$20/mo for the same feature set as ChatGPT+. It does not currently make any effort to support locally-hosted open source models.
